data_source.original_source_study: Eurasian griffon vulture in France (Grands Causses 2018) ID_PROG 961
data_source.existing_native_dual_sensor_result: 27 birds, 5205 bird days, 364520 GPS events, two altitude series support bird-ID height distribution.

new_climate_source.provider: ECMWF CERRA Europe ~5km via Open-Meteo Historical Archive
new_climate_source.centroid_method: For each of the EXACT 28 originally altitude-blind admitted birds, compute the median longitude and median latitude of that bird's earliest selected 5minute native flying GPS observations across all 2019-2021 source days. Compute the median of those 28 bird medians to define the one region-scale source reference coordinate. Round to 6 decimals before fixed weather API queries. No native height, barometric height or decoded Wstar outcome is used.
new_climate_source.atmospheric_state_def: For each year-calendar-month, collect the daily MEAN of 24 regional CERRA hourly 100m wind values, retain date only with ≥20 numeric wind hours, and define low≤calendar day 25th percentile, high≥75th percentile among ALL weather calendar days in that same year-month, middle otherwise. No GPS event count or altitude effect determines weather thresholds.
new_climate_source.solar_field: Collected as a descriptive solar influx proxy but NOT primary and NOT an outcome-tuned alternative to wind.
new_climate_source.interpretation: Single region-gridded 100m wind measures Grands Causses area weather, not flight-site wind, orographic lift or physical air mass actually experienced by individual vultures.

noheight_eligibility.source_filter: Reuse exact 2019-21 source-native Gyps fulvus GPS: valid ID/date/WGS84, native speed 5–55m/s, exclude source invisible/outlier, EARLIEST time/XY valid event per bird×UTC day×5min before height; retain original 28 admitted bird IDs only.
noheight_eligibility.horizontal: EPSG:6933 global equal-area, original 5km cell, original archive all 2019-2021 calendar dates
noheight_eligibility.score_unit: bird, with low/high wind days within individual, not GPS event
noheight_eligibility.shared_species_model_reference: For the same UTC-yearmonth and 5km cell, at least TWO OTHER distinct biological birds each with ≥10 selected nonheight GPS fixes in BOTH low and high wind day regimes on OTHER dates after excluding the target date's whole flock. This guards species-level common response against wind-specific donor bird-composition bias.
noheight_eligibility.panel_primary_admission: At least10 birds separately with >=2 low and 2 high distinct UTC days meeting BOTH the individual-wind donor test and shared OTHER-bird/other-date wind donor test.
noheight_eligibility.freeze_group: Any results from new weather source must be recorded independent of previous native altitude outcome and of previous gyro wind labels; environment hypothesis devised AFTER original dual sensor results and is NOT a newly preregistered blind height outcome.

future_models_if_source_passes.M0: Own wind-pooled centered native GPS/barometric height distributions, per bird×5km cell
future_models_if_source_passes.M1: Own wind-pooled distribution adjusted by species-common low/high CERRA regional wind odds from other birds in same original 5km cell and YYYY-MM, excluding focal bird/target UTC date
future_models_if_source_passes.M2: Own bird×wind low/high profile distributions learned only from other dates
future_models_if_source_passes.primary_contrast: M2−M1 held-out-day log predictive gain tests additional bird-specific regional wind information beyond species-common response; same target GPS events each model and two native altitude sensors, full original source eligibility fixed independently of height QC.
future_models_if_source_passes.secondary_contrast: M1−M0 shared wind response, descriptive, not an additional independent confirmatory study.
future_models_if_source_passes.null: 999 shuffles of FULL calendar date regional wind labels within each year-month, synchronized across all birds sharing the same regional climate grid cell and date; retrain M1/M2 and recompute biological bird eligibility for each shuffle. Never shuffle GPS fixes or bird labels as if dates independent.
future_models_if_source_passes.dual_sensor: Exactly paired native GPS and barometric measurements; Holm over the 2 correlated sensor channels if inferential, sensor agreement itself is not independent instrumentation proof.
shared_caveats: The native GPS/barometric source height outcome has ALREADY been opened for the D1 identity test; this new environment contrast is EXPLORATORY/POST-OUTCOME within the same source.
Tag and biological bird remain aliased; no physical tag-swap or precise terrain/flight-mode controls.
One region CERRA site wind is not local Wstar thermal uplift; an environmental association cannot be labeled a causal thermalling response.
If shared-reference matched context fails n≥10, keep unavailable; never broaden to 50km or relax monthly/donor/day constraints.

current_goal: Run fixed independent CERRA weather assignment and source-meta 5km shared-wind donor counts without reading any numeric altitude, then decide candidly if the source can support a meaningful species-common vs bird-specific weather test.
